department: Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics and Statistics, Promotionsausschuss

deadline.value: No application deadline is stated; applications go to the doctoral committee through the online doctoral portal.

gre_subject.value: The faculty pages do not mention a GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: Admission needs a supervisor confirmation (Betreuungsbestätigung) from the supervisor and two referees before the acceptance notice is issued.

also.quote: Der Annahmebescheid kann nur gegen Vorlage aller erforderlichen Unterlagen ausgehändigt werden

funding.value: The faculty pages do not say how doctoral students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants submit bachelor's or master's certificates; a bachelor's-only candidate needs the doctoral aptitude exam.

notes: One faculty doctorate: the faculty's doctoral regulations (Promotionsordnung) cover Mathematik, Informatik und Statistik, so statistics and computer science are listed as also_fields. The page does not mention a GRE, funding or English rule.
